name: Ormic Launcher
description:
A floating app launcher and application grid system designed for GNOME Shell. This extension provides a fully adaptive, glassmorphic layout that seamlessly integrates into your desktop environment, offering highly responsive mouse and keyboard event handling for quick navigation.

Key features include:
* Smooth, adaptive glassmorphic user interface
* Customizable application grouping for better organization
* Full keyboard and mouse navigation support
* Quick search capabilities to launch applications instantly
